name: cockpit
description: Live session dashboard in one side pane (/cockpit). Mods: agents-progress (/agents-info), cache-keeper (/keepwarm, /cache-tax), context-health (/ctx-handoff, /autohandoff), token-meter, usage-limits, filetree (/filetree), next-steps, architect, permission-gate, loops, turn-receipt, session-log.

agentsProgress.title: agents-progress
agentsProgress.description: Progress panel with main-session activity, subagents and background tasks, plus running-agents, background and todo/task bands above the prompt

cacheKeeper.title: cache-keeper
cacheKeeper.description: Cache countdown band, /keepwarm pings and a cold-send dialog with cost estimate

contextHealth.title: context-health
contextHealth.description: Context fill band with turn, speed, cost, dismiss, warnings, /ctx-handoff and /autohandoff

filetree.title: filetree
filetree.description: File tree pane with git status and highlights for files Claude reads and writes

nextSteps.title: next-steps
nextSteps.description: Suggests three next prompts after each turn

tokenMeter.title: token-meter
tokenMeter.description: Session token count in the status line; Details shows token types, project total, cost and models

usageLimits.title: usage-limits
usageLimits.description: Always-visible band with session (5h) and weekly (7d) limit usage, reset countdown, pace and a toast at 90%

architect.title: architect
architect.description: Architect panel: consults with advisor-type agents or server tools on a timeline, their inferred moment and advice

permissionGate.title: permission-gate
permissionGate.description: Gate panel: one cell per permission check (allowed, cleared, pending, denied) with file/shell/other drill-downs

loops.title: loops
loops.description: Loops row: model loops no agent card claims (workflow agents, compactions, forks)

turnReceipt.title: turn-receipt
turnReceipt.description: Receipt panel: the running turn's clock, or the last turn's duration, agents, edits, errors and cost

sessionLog.title: session-log
sessionLog.description: Session log panel: prompts, spawns, completions, consults, edits, errors and denials

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the pane's connectors while real work flows, or keep them still

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: an 8-row summary when the pane sits inline above the prompt, two columns from 110 columns when docked, one column otherwise

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the cockpit pane when a session starts (Claude Code seats it unasked only in terminals 144+ columns wide)

paneColumns.title: Pane width
paneColumns.description: Columns the pane asks for when docked beside a fullscreen transcript, 40 or more; a width you dragged it to wins

maxCards.title: Cards before swimlanes
maxCards.description: Agent cards drawn side by side; more agents than this switch to swimlanes (1-6)

architectPattern.title: Architect pattern
architectPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for the agent types and server tools that count as the architect

matchDescriptions.title: Match agent descriptions
matchDescriptions.description: Also count an agent type as the architect when its description matches the pattern

moments.title: Architect moments
moments.description: Show the inferred moment of each consult (before a plan, error repeats, before done)

architectLabel.title: Architect label
architectLabel.description: Name shown for the architect panel

gateLabel.title: Gate label
gateLabel.description: Name shown for the permission panel
